bio.text: Scott Fitzgerald was elected in 2020 and represents Wisconsin's 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He served in the Wisconsin State Senate for the 13th District from 1995 to 2021, including as Majority Leader and Minority Leader.
He served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1981 and retired in 2009 as a lieutenant colonel.
He was born in Chicago in 1963, earned a B.S. from the University of Wisconsin-Oshkosh in 1985, and lives in Clyman, Wisconsin.
